value.rationale: Simultaneous density and occupied-area requirements arise from published Allee critical-area evidence. The result solves the exact globally minimal founder mass under a genuine mean-squared-dispersal constraint and physical finite-anisotropy cap. It identifies two dimension-dependent sharp volume thresholds, a universal linear intermediate regime, a positive small-target founder floor, and a nontrivial finite eigenvalue-multiplicity selection problem; these are interpretable benchmark design boundaries rather than arbitrary parameter samples. No claim of actual survival is made.
